content: Konva 10.3.0 (MIT) is a 2D canvas library with first-class Layers, draggable Nodes (draggable:true), Image nodes for photo backgrounds and round avatar markers (with clipFunc/FillPatternImage), Transformer for resize/rotate, and hit-detection. react-konva binds it to React. Ideal free/OSS base for the map editor (image background + shapes/lines/zones + layers + draggable markers).
